The general similar-plane-area theorem gives A/a=sqrt(2025)=45; no absolute ellipse-area formula is used. The foci order F-G-H puts the center separation at d=e(A+a)>0. To justify the common right vertex without trusting drawing scale, place the large center at 0 and the small at d on the x-axis. A small-boundary point is (d+a*u,k*a*v), with u^2+v^2=1. Containment and contact therefore force d+a=A; otherwise the smaller ellipse would either protrude or be strictly interior. Hence e(A+a)=A-a and e=(45-1)/(45+1)=22/23, D.
